name: Gorafe (Spain)
description: Vertically divided green and yellow, charged at the centre with a white shield bearing a red dolmen within a red bordure.
history: Gorafe adopted its arms and flag officially on 24 October 2007; the flag is rectangular of 2:3, formed of two equal vertical stripes, green at the hoist and yellow at the fly, with a white shield charged with a red dolmen and a red bordure.

features.role: white shield with a red dolmen and red bordure
dolmen and bordure of the shield
